title: Verify the work-order history still shows fee/discount entries even when the Fees & Discounts feature is off
custom_preconds:
1. A work order already has fee/discount history entries.
  2. The user has Work Orders: Create and Edit (to view the work-order history log).
  3. Ability to set the Fees & Discounts feature OFF.
custom_steps:
1. In Administration, turn the Fees & Discounts feature off.
  2. Open a work order's history and look for the fee/discount entries recorded earlier.
  3. Turn the feature back on afterwards.
custom_expected:
1. Fee/discount history entries stay visible in the work-order history even with the feature off (the one exception to 'feature off hides everything').
  2. All other fee/discount screens are still hidden.
